releases.body:
## Highlights

- Genes with NaN counts are ignored with a warning instead of raising an error, and get NaN dispersions, LFCs and p-values (#502).
- `plot_MA` and `plot_dispersions` take matplotlib axes through a new `ax` argument (#504).
- A fitted `DeseqDataSet` can be written to h5ad (#477, #510).
- An empty count matrix raises a clear error (#503).
- LFC shrinkage and the dispersion fitting fallbacks were corrected (#470, #471, #472), as were `poscounts` size factors for genes whose positive counts are all 1 (#494).
- The synthetic example dataset ships with the wheel, so `load_example_data` works without the repository (#467).
- The documentation has a new tutorial on continuous covariates (#507).
- PyDESeq2 works with pandas 3.1 and anndata 0.13 (#456, #501).
- The test suite compares PyDESeq2 with DESeq2 1.50.2, which it runs through rpy2 (#505).

## Changed behaviour

- Status updates and timings are logged through the shared scverse logger and are hidden by default (#506).
  Set `scverse_misc.logging.config.verbosity = "info"` to see them.
  `summary()` and `lfc_shrink()` still print their results table.
- `uns["trend_coeffs"]` and `uns["vst_trend_coeffs"]` are dicts with the keys `a0` and `a1` instead of pandas Series, and `obsm["design_matrix"]` is a plain DataFrame (#477, #510).
- Python 3.12 or later is required, and the minimum supported dependencies follow SPEC 0 (#458).
- scverse-misc is a new dependency (#506).

## What's Changed
* docs: fix broken intersphinx links by @Ekin-Kahraman in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/442
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/439
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/446
* Fix AttributeError when design is a DataFrame by @Ekin-Kahraman in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/443
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/448
* Fix type errors surfaced by anndata 0.13 by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/456
* Move test dependencies into a `test` dependency group by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/455
* Remove CODEOWNERS by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/457
* Align minimum supported dependencies with SPEC 0 by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/458
* Adopt the scverse cookiecutter template 0.8.0 by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/459
* Chore(deps): bump the actions-deps group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/460
* Split utils into modules grouped by theme by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/461
* Move the docs to the template layout and restyle them by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/462
* Remove duplicated types from docstrings by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/463
* Fix load_example_data for non-editable installs by bundling datasets/ into the wheel by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/467
* Fix README logo path after docs restructure by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/474
* docs: move to scverse-doc and adopt the shared scverse docs TOC by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/487
* ci: add autofix.ci workflow by @flying-sheep in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/496
* style: switch to panache markdown formatting by @flying-sheep in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/495
* Chore(deps): bump the pre-commit group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/497
* build: require scverse-doc 0.4 by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/488
* Chore(deps): bump the pre-commit group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/499
* Fix prior curvature in shrinkage Hessian by @Intron7 in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/470
* Preserve dispersion regularization in optimizer fallback by @Intron7 in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/471
* Honor the requested coefficient in shrinkage grid fallback by @Intron7 in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/472
* Chore(deps): bump the actions-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/486
* fix: adapt to pandas 3.1 deprecations by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/501
* Keep genes whose positive counts are all 1 in poscounts size factors by @MMatinGerami in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/494
* feat: ignore genes with NaN counts instead of raising by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/502
* fix: raise a clear error for an empty count matrix by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/503
* style: raise the line length to 120 by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/508
* docs: add a tutorial on continuous covariates by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/507
* build: add Lukas Heumos to the authors by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/509
* feat: accept matplotlib axes in plot_MA and plot_dispersions by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/504
* feat: log status updates through the shared scverse logger by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/506
* test: compare with DESeq2 through rpy2 in a dedicated environment by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/505
* Store dispersion trend coefficients as a dict so the dataset can be written to h5ad by @raashish1601 in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/477
* fix: store the design matrix as a DataFrame so the dataset can be written to h5ad by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/510
* docs: rewrite the README in the style of the scverse template by @Zethson in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/511

## New Contributors
* @Ekin-Kahraman made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/442
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/460
* @flying-sheep made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/496
* @Intron7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/470
* @MMatinGerami made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/494
* @raashish1601 made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/pull/477

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/scverse/PyDESeq2/compare/v0.5.4...v0.6.0
